== Creating the page ==

I really thought this ought to have its own page and was surprised when it didn't. It is only mentioned briefly on the ''saidar ''page and does not seem to be described in detail anywhere else on the net either despite being a moderately important topic (certainly more so than many other things that have their own pages). The current page is essentially just a draft and I intend to research and refine it later - in the meantime please feel free to add or change whatever you wish.
